Reliability notes
-----------------
- Semantic reprocess is an additive background task. It never rewrites transcript.jsonl.
- On shutdown, in-progress semantic reprocess tasks are cancelled and marked interrupted rather than left as falsely-running state.
- After process restart, stale queued/running reprocess metadata is surfaced as interrupted and can be started again.
- Semantic status counts are calculated from the latest sidecar record per transcript id, preventing repeated rechecks from double-counting historical annotations.
- UI falls back to raw/human display text whenever the semantic suggestion is absent, below threshold, human-marked uncertain/wrong, or manually edited.

Not executed by request
-----------------------
- No real Ollama/OpenAI semantic quality benchmark.
- No real GPU/CUDA model test.
- No multi-hour audio throughput test.
- No browser screenshot/visual automation; this release was validated statically and with Mock/state simulations only.
